recipes.name: Cookie Cat inspired by Steven Universe
ingredients: For the Easy Vanilla Ice Cream
7 oz sweetened condensed milk (about half the can)
For the No Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
instructions: For the Cookie
Combine flour and cocoa powder in a small bowl. Using a fine mesh sieve, sift the flour mixture onto a piece of parchment paper. - 160 g flour - 80 g cocoa powder

In the bowl of a stand mixer, cream together the butter, sugar, baking soda and salt for 5 minutes until the mixture is well combined and fluffy. - 75 g butter soft - 50 g light brown sugar - 100 g white sugar - ½ tsp baking soda - ½ tsp salt
Combine the vanilla and milk in a small bowl. - ¾ tsp vanilla extract - 110 g milk

With the mixer running on a low speed, tip 1/3 of the dry ingredients, then half of the milk. Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the bowl, then add another 1/3 of the dry ingredients and the remaining milk and the vanilla. Scrape the bowl down once more and add the remaining dry ingredients, mix until just combined. - 160 g flour - 80 g cocoa powder - 75 g butter soft - 50 g light brown sugar - 100 g white sugar - ½ tsp baking soda - ½ tsp salt - ¾ tsp vanilla extract - 110 g milk
Roll the dough out to 4 mm thickness between two pieces of parchment. - For the Cookie
Remove the top layer of parchment and cut out the cookie design using a cutter. - For the Cookie
Transfer the cookies to a large rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment paper. - For the Cookie
Bake at 350°F for 7-10 minutes, just until the cookies look dry. - For the Cookie
Allow the cookies to cool on the sheet tray until completely cool. - For the Cookie
For the No-Churn Vanilla Ice Cream
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. - 8 oz heavy cream cold - 2 oz clotted cream - 7 oz sweetened condensed milk (about half the can) - ½ tsp salt - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1 oz mascarpone
Whisk together using an electric mixer until very thick, about 3-4 minutes.
Spread the cream mixture onto one side of a parchment-lined baking sheet. Reserve in the refrigerator until the other flavor is prepared. - For the Easy Vanilla Ice Cream
For the No-Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
Combine all ingredients, except for the strawberry puree, in a large bowl. - 6 oz heavy cream - 2 oz clotted cream* - 6 oz sweetened condensed milk - ½ tsp salt - 1 tsp vanilla extract
Whisk together using an electric mixer until very thick, about 3-4 minutes.
Fold in the strawberry puree. - 6 ½ oz strawberry puree
Spread the cream mixture onto the other side of the parchment lined baking sheet. - For the No Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
Once both sides of the sheet tray are covered, smooth the top with a large offset spatula.
Cover the surface of the ice cream mixtures with a piece of parchment paper. - For the Easy Vanilla Ice Cream - For the No Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
Wrap the whole sheet tray in plastic wrap and freeze until solid, 24 hours. - For the Easy Vanilla Ice Cream - For the No Churn Strawberry Ice Cream
*Substitute for clotting cream: Combine mascarpone and heavy cream in a small bowl. Whisk well to combine.
For the Strawberry Puree
Trim the tops and slice the strawberries in half. - 8 oz strawberries
Transfer the strawberries to a quarter-rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment. - 8 oz strawberries
Roast at 350°F for 25 minutes.
Remove the strawberries from the oven and let them cool on the sheet tray for 15 minutes. - 8 oz strawberries
Puree the roasted strawberries in a food processor or blender. - 8 oz strawberries
Strain the mixture and reserve the liquid. Discard the excess pulp. - 8 oz strawberries
For the Cookie Cat Assembly

Cut the ice cream using the same size cookie cutter used for cutting the cookie dough. Place the ice cream layer on top of one of the cooled cookies. Make sure the ice cream layer is aligned with the cookie. - For the Easy Vanilla Ice Cream - For the No Churn Strawberry Ice Cream - For the Cookie
Place another cookie on top and freeze the sandwich for 2-4 hours, or until completely firm. - For the Cookie
Remove from the freezer and enjoy immediately.
